rows.what_the_ink_shows: The initial arrow in crops/93_scan170_L72_cycles_codomain.jpg ends at a large Z with superscript star and subscript B/A, followed by the parenthetical cycles de Omega. In crops/93_scan170_L72_unique_hom.jpg, Il y a un hom unique psi is clearly written, and condition (a) calls psi a hom d'anneaux. The conditions in crops/93_scan170_L72_conditions.jpg give psi_0(x)=x^p and psi(d_{B/A}x)=x^{p-1}d_{B/A}x. The passage in crops/93_scan170_L72_product_check.jpg says that it suffices to verify the displayed product rule, writes that rule and its expansion, and concludes ce qui est trivial; it supplies no additivity check there. At the bottom, crops/93_scan170_L72_cohomology_composite.jpg shows the subsequent arrow from Z to de Rham H and the boxed phi with target H^*_{DR}(B/A). These are all represented in the source; the initial Z has not been misread for H.
rows.note: Written: a unique ring homomorphism psi from the differential algebra into its cycles, with psi(dx)=x^{p-1}dx, followed by the product-rule verification; the later boxed morphism has de Rham cohomology as target. Retain this sequence as written. The row's proposed mathematical correction is "psi is not additive into Z^*: the defect is d(((x+y)^p - x^p - y^p)/p) (p = 2: d(xy)); over F_2[x], d(x+1) = dx but (x+1)dx != x dx; the homomorphism exists into H^*_DR (Cartier's C^-1), the composite he uses next". The asserted additivity defect, the characteristic-two example, and the identification with Cartier's inverse are carried as unproved background in this visual review. The cited program and earlier dossier were not run or independently verified. Existing uncertainty in the underbrace and other peripheral or torn text is preserved.

source_context:
Il y a un hom unique $\psi$, satisfaisant les conditions

a) $\psi$ est un hom d'anneaux

b) $\psi_0(x)=\underbrace{x^p}_{\unsure{F_B(x)|\psi_0(x)}}$ si $x\in B\simeq\Omega^0_{B/A}$.

c) $\psi(d_{B/A}x)=\underbrace{x^{p-1}d_{B/A}x}_{\partial x}$ si $x\in B$.

Pour vérifier ceci, il suffit de vérifier que l'on a
\[
 \partial(xy)=\psi_0(x)\partial y+\psi_0(y)\partial x
\]
i.e.
\[
 (xy)^{p-1}d(xy)=x^py^{p-1}dy+y^px^{p-1}dx
\]
ce qui est trivial.
